title: TOPN returns more than N rows when there is a tie at the N-th row

source.quote: If there is a tie, in Order_By values, at the N-th row of the table, then all tied rows are returned.
source.supports: ties at the N-th row are all returned

derivation: Player scores: Ann 90, Bob 80, Cho 80, Dee 70, Eve 70, Fay 50. Descending: 90, then 80 twice. The second row ties with the third, so both Bob and Cho come back: 3 rows for N = 2.
